title: Null pointer crash in nsHttpChannel::OnStopRequest when response is cancelled
description: Firefox crashes intermittently when downloading large assets over HTTP/2 and the user navigates away before stream completion. nsHttpChannel fails to check if mListener is null before calling OnStopRequest.
stack_trace:
Crash [@ nsHttpChannel::OnStopRequest(nsIRequest*, nsISupports*, tag_nsresult)]
0  xul.dll!nsHttpChannel::OnStopRequest [nsHttpChannel.cpp:6840]
1  xul.dll!nsInputStreamPump::OnStateStop [nsInputStreamPump.cpp:692]
2  xul.dll!nsInputStreamPump::EnsureWaiting [nsInputStreamPump.cpp:588]
3  xul.dll!nsThread::ProcessNextEvent [nsThread.cpp:1152]
comments: Patch landed in bug 104820 by jduell. Added null-check for mListener prior to invoking OnStopRequest callback.

title: IndexedDB transaction aborted with UnknownError during rapid quota eviction
description: When multiple worker threads attempt write operations to IndexedDB while browser storage manager triggers eviction, transactions abort prematurely with UnknownError without giving error callback to developer.
stack_trace:
IndexedDB Error: DOMException: The operation failed for reasons unrelated to the database itself and not covered by any other error code.
  at IDBTransaction.commit (IndexedDatabaseManager.cpp:412)
  at StorageQuotaManager.cpp:892
error_message: DOMException: The database connection is closing.
comments: Fixed by implementing graceful transaction rollback and notifying transaction listeners with AbortError rather than silent crash.

title: JavaScript engine assertion failure in IonMonkey JIT compiler for deep recursion
description: Deeply recursive arrow functions in WebAssembly glue code cause stack overflow in IonMonkey JIT compiler instead of throwing RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded.
stack_trace:
Assertion failure: cx->isThrowingOutOfMemory() || cx->isThrowingOverRecursed()
  at js::jit::CompileBackedge (Ion.cpp:2184)
  at js::jit::CanEnter (Ion.cpp:2340)
error_message: Assertion failure in IonMonkey JIT: stack pointer misaligned or out of bounds
comments: Added explicit stack limit check in IonBuilder before inlining recursion frames.

title: Memory leak in WebGL canvas rendering context on rapid page reload
description: WebGL contexts allocated inside hidden iframes do not release GPU textures when iframe is detached from DOM, causing GPU memory consumption to climb monotonically.
stack_trace: WebGLContext::DestroyResources() was not invoked for detached canvas element at WebGLContext.cpp:1140
error_message: GPU memory allocation failed: out of VRAM
comments: Fixed by hooking iframe detachment listener in nsDocument and unbinding textures explicitly.

title: Authentication token header stripped during cross-origin redirect
description: When a fetch request with custom Authorization header encounters a 302 redirect to a subdomain on the same root domain, the browser strips the Authorization header incorrectly.
error_message: Security Error: Cross-Origin Request Blocked: The Same Origin Policy disallows reading the remote resource
comments: Updated CORS header preservation logic to retain headers when explicitly allowed by Access-Control-Allow-Headers on target host.
